rhopgradient.comment: Initial density gradient 1:Rhop0, 2:Water column, 3:Max. water height (default=2).

hswl.comment: Maximum still water level to calculate speedofsound using coefsound

gamma.comment: Polytropic constant for water used in the state equation

speedsystem.comment: Maximum system speed (by default the dam-break propagation is used)

speedsound.comment: Speed of sound to use in the simulation (by default speedofsound=coefsound*speedsystem)

coefh.comment: Coefficient to calculate the smoothing length (h=coefh*sqrt(3*dp^2) in 3D)

norgeometry.comment: Define initial configuration of normals before applying other configurations

distanceh.comment: Maximum orthogonal distance (H*value) to compute normals data (default=2)

svshapes.comment: Saves VTK with geometry in triangles and quads with its normals for debug (default=false)

limitmin.comment: Location where minimum reduction is applied

limitmax.comment: Location where maximum reduction is applied

overlimit.comment: The scope of maximum reduction over limitmax (default=0)

domain.comment: Box domain to apply damping (default=all domain)

useboxlimit.comment: In/out process is only applied to InOut zones delimited by BoxLimit (default=true)

determlimit.comment: Use 1e-3 for first_order or 1e+3 for zeroth_order (default=1e+3)

extrapolatemode.comment: Calculation mode for rhop and velocity extrapolation from ghost nodes 1:fast-single, 2:single, 3:double (default=1)

refilling.comment: Refilling mode. 0:Simple full, 1:Simple below zsurf, 2:Advanced for reverse flows (very slow) (default=1)

inputtreatment.comment: Treatment of fluid entering the zone. 0:No changes, 1:Convert fluid (necessary for outlet), 2:Remove fluid (recommended for inlet)

imposevelocity.comment: Imposed velocity 0:fixed value, 1:variable value, 2:Extrapolated velocity, 3:Interpolated velocity (default=0)

imposerhop.comment: Outlet rhop 0:Imposed fixed value, 1:Hydrostatic, 2:Extrapolated from ghost nodes (default=0)

imposezsurf.comment: Inlet Z-surface 0:Imposed fixed value, 1:Imposed variable value, 2:Calculated from fluid domain (default=0)

savevtk.comment: Creates VTK files with Zsurf for each PART (default=false)

remove.comment: Removes particles above the Zsurf limit (default=false)

refilling.comment: Refilling mode. 0:Simple full, 1:Simple below zsurf, 2:Advanced for reverse flows (very slow) (default=1)

inputtreatment.comment: Treatment of fluid entering the zone. 0:No changes, 1:Convert fluid (necessary for outlet), 2:Remove fluid (recommended for inlet)

imposerhop.comment: Outlet rhop 0:Imposed fixed value, 1:Hydrostatic, 2:Extrapolated from ghost nodes (default=0)

savevtkpart.comment: Creates VTK files for each PART (default=false)

computetime.comment: Start and end of measures. (default=simulation time)

output.comment: Creates CSV and binary files of measurements (default=false)

outputdt.comment: Time between output measurements. 0:all computed measurements (default=TimeOut)

outputtime.comment: Start and end of output measures. (default=simulation time)

savevtkpart.comment: Creates VTK files for each PART (default=default.savevtkpart)

target.comment: Indicates the mkbound of selected particles to compute forces

ignore.comment: Ignore filters every nparts output files (default=0)

parameter.comment: Saves particle position using double precision (default=0)
Slip mode for mDBC 1:DBC vel=0, 2:No-slip, 3:Free slip (default=1)
Prevents fluid penetration into boundary (only with SlipMode 2 and 3) (default=1)
Verlet only: Number of steps to apply Euler timestepping (default=40)
Threshold to detect free surface. Typically 1.5 for 2D and 2.75 for 3D (default=0)
Non conservative pressure formulation for advanced shifting (default=0)
Time to freeze the floatings at simulation start (warmup) (default=0)
Coefficient to calculate minimum time step dtmin=coefdtmin*h/speedsound (default=0.05)
Initial time step. Use 0 to default use (default=h/speedsound)
Minimum time step. Use 0 to default use (default=coefdtmin*h/speedsound)
Velocity of particles used to calculate DT. 1:All, 0:Only fluid/floating (default=0)
Minimum proportion of initial fluid particles to continue the simulation 0:Never stops, 0.1:Stops when fluid drops to 10%. (default=0)

simulationdomain.comment: Defines domain of simulation (default=Uses minimum and maximum position of the generated particles)
